# Rice, Roots & Rolls – An Asian Kitchen (Spring Lake / Fort Bragg, NC)

> Authentic Cambodian comfort food, wok-fired Chinese favorites, and fresh hand-rolled sushi crafted daily by Chef A (Leakhena Ouk-Hester) at 1124 N Bragg Blvd, Spring Lake, NC 28390.

## Core Business & Wayfinding Information
- **Official Name:** Rice, Roots & Rolls – An Asian Kitchen
- **Owner & Executive Chef:** Chef A (Leakhena Ouk-Hester)
- **Origin Story:** Born in a little red food truck called *Far East Foodie* in Lander, Wyoming, now rooted at 1124 N Bragg Blvd in Spring Lake, NC (5 minutes from Fort Bragg gates).
- **Address:** 1124 N Bragg Blvd, Spring Lake, NC 28390
- **GPS Coordinates:** `35.1776006, -78.9795992`
- **Phone (Call or Text for Takeout & Catering):** (910) 920-1159 (`tel:9109201159`)
- **Email:** fareastfoodiewy@gmail.com
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/CQzkFrkVHxttnsVk6
- **Hours of Operation:**
  - Monday – Thursday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
  - Friday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 8:30 PM
  - Sunday: CLOSED (Family Day)

## Signature Dishes & Menu Highlights (36 Scratch Dishes & Rolls)
- **Southeast Asian & Khmer Specials:**
  - Kathiew (Authentic Cambodian Pho) — $15.95
  - Meekong River Noodles — $15.95
  - Chicken or Pork Vermicelli Noodle Bowl with Khmer Egg Roll & Koh Kong Vinaigrette — $15.95
  - Bai Saik Chruk (Khmer Char-Grilled Marinated Pork with Pickled Daikon & Koh Kong Sauce) — $15.95
  - Bai Saik Maon (Khmer Char-Grilled Chicken Thigh) — $15.95
- **Chef's Traditional Khmer Specials:**
  - Cambodian Country Curry — $15.95
  - Trey Chein (Whole Crispy Fried Tilapia with Cambodian Vinaigrette) — $24.95
  - Somlah Machu (Cambodian Lemongrass Kreung Beef Sour Soup) — $17.95
- **Squad Leader Specialty Sushi Rolls & Crudo:**

  - The Wyoming Cowboy Roll (Stir-fried ribeye, asparagus, green onion, chili & yum yum) — $15.95
  - The Screaming Eagle Roll — $16.95
  - The 24th ID Roll — $16.95
  - The All American Roll (82nd Airborne Tribute) — $16.95
- **Classic Rolls, Crispy Starters, Soups & Wok Favorites:**
